[[File:Etniile din România 2021.png|thumb|Ethnic map of [[Romania]] according to the results of the 2021 census]]
The '''2021 Romanian census''' ({{langx|ro|Recensământul Populației și Locuințelor 2021 (RPL2021)}}) was a [[census]] held in [[Romania]] between 1 February and 31 July 2022,<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 February 2022 |editor-last=Bonea |editor-first=Monica |title=Calendarul recensământului din România, care începe astăzi. Este primul care va avea loc doar online |trans-title=The calendar of the survey from Romania, that begins today. It is the first that will take place online only |url=https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/calendarul-recensamantului-din-romania-este-primul-care-va-avea-loc-doar-online-nu-se-va-folosi-hartia-in-nicio-etapa-1822597 |website=[[Digi24]] |language=ro}}</ref> with the reference day for the census data set at 1 December 2021.<ref name="provisional">{{Cite web |url=https://insse.ro/cms/en/content/population-and-housing-census-2021-provisional-results |title=Population and housing census, 2021 - provisional results |website=insse.ro |date=30 December 2022}}</ref> The census was supposed to be done in 2021, but it was postponed due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]] in order to avoid census takers from getting infected when coming into contact with ill or quarantined people. It was the first census held in Romania in which data was collected [[Online and offline|online]], something that had support among Romanian youth.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=6 January 2021 |editor-last=Marina |editor-first=Georgiana |title=Recensământul populației nu va mai avea loc în 2021. A fost amânat pentru 2022, iar datele vor fi colectate și online |trans-title=The population census will no longer take place in 2021. It was postponed for 2022, and the data will be collected even online |url=https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/social/recensamantul-populatiei-nu-va-mai-avea-loc-in-2021-a-fost-amanat-pentru-2022-iar-datele-vor-fi-colectate-si-online-1429101 |website=Digi24 |language=ro}}</ref>

The census was divided into three phases: one in which personal data of the Romanian population was collected from various sites; another in which the population was to complete more precise data such as religion, in which [[town hall]]s would help the natives of rural areas to answer the census; and a third one in which census takers would go to the homes and households of those who did not register their data online.<ref name=":0" />

Data for this census was planned not to be collected on paper, but instead with [[Tablet computer|tablets]] so as to maintain [[social distancing]] between citizens. The entire data collection process was also relatively long, spanning about 6 months. People who did not provide data by themselves in the early stages of the census were not fined, but those who refused to give or gave false information could be fined between 1,000 and 3,000 [[Romanian leu|Romanian lei]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=20 January 2021 |title=Recensământul locuințelor și al populației (ediția 2022) în 8 întrebări și răspunsuri |language=ro |trans-title=The housing and population survey (2022 edition) in 8 questions and answers |work=[[HotNews]] |url=https://economie.hotnews.ro/stiri-finante_banci-24552245-recensamantul-locuintelor-populatiei-editia-2021-8-intrebari-raspunsuri.htm}}</ref>

On 1 August 2022, it was officially announced by the [[National Institute of Statistics (Romania)|National Institute of Statistics]] (INS) that as many as 18.15 million Romanian citizens were registered at the RPL2021.<ref>{{cite web|lang=ro|url=https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/social/recenzarea-s-a-incheiat-peste-18-milioane-de-romani-s-au-inregistrat-pana-la-finalul-zilei-de-31-iulie-2032925|title=Recenzarea s-a încheiat. Peste 18 milioane de români s-au înregistrat până la finalul zilei de 31 iulie|work=Digi24.ro|author=Alina Popescu|date=1 August 2022|accessdate=2 August 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|lang=en|url=http://www.nineoclock.ro/2022/08/01/census-2021-as-many-as-18-15-million-people-have-been-recorded-by-july-31|work=Nine O'clock News|title=Census 2021: As many as 18.15 million people have been recorded by July 31|date=1 August 2022|accessdate=3 August 2022}}</ref> Subsequently, the head of the INS announced the first data of the RPL2021 on 5 August 2022, stating that Romania had {{circa|19 million}} inhabitants.<ref>{{cite web|lang=ro|url=https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/seful-ins-a-anuntat-primele-date-ale-recensamantului-2022-romania-are-19-milioane-de-locuitori-cu-un-milion-mai-putin-fata-de-2011-2037483|title=Șeful INS a anunțat primele date ale Recensământului 2022: România are 19 milioane de locuitori, cu un milion mai puțin față de 2011|work=Digi24.ro|author=Alexandra Andronie|date=5 August 2022|accessdate=5 August 2022}}</ref>

The final results regarding demographic characteristics of the RPL2021, published on 31 May 2023, showed a resident population in Romania of 19,053,815 people.<ref name="RPL2021"/>
